doubts: Page lists walking options: there and back on Webb Creek Track (main), circuit with Billygoat Track, and the shorter Billygoat Circuit (a separate linked walk, no start or end given, so not a way). DOC's time/distance are one way to the hut; the main way uses the section's 2 hr 30 min – 3 hr one way and 6 km. Road end start has no clear feature (F1-F3 are different tracks at Kauaeranga Valley Road), so null. Whether the circuit visits Pinnacles Hut is not explicit; included because the option's time (7 – 8 hr 30 min) and the Hydro Camp return wording suggest it. The Billygoat leg crosses the Kauaeranga River with no bridge, then walks the road 300 m north to the road end car park.
